decks.notes: This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board with cards like Duress and Cut Down, while also efficiently removing threats with Go for the Throat and Legions to Ashes. The deck also aims to apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures such as Archfiend of the Dross and Preacher of the Schism. Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber provides additional resources, while cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Cruelclaw's Heist offer powerful late-game plays. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing for a fast and relentless assault on the opponent.

The deck focuses on using Omniscience to cast multiple spells for free in a single turn, allowing the player to amass a large board presence and overwhelm the opponent. It includes various spells that can create an explosive combo, such as Roiling Dragonstorm and Temporary Lockdown. The deck also includes cards like Marang River Regent and Oracle of Tragedy to provide additional advantage and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the casting of multiple colored spells, ensuring consistency in executing the combo efficiently.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive board presence, utilizing cards like Monument to Endurance and Phyrexian Dragon Engine to quickly overwhelm opponents. With support cards like Helping Hand and Recommission to protect creatures and generate card advantage, this deck aims to maintain pressure and close out games quickly. The inclusion of removal spells like Torch the Tower and Burst Lightning allows for disrupting opponents' strategies, while cards like Fear of Missing Out and Guardian of New Benalia provide additional threats to keep up the pressure.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on utilizing a variety of spells and abilities to control the game, with a mix of creature removal, counterspells, and card draw. The aim is to stall the opponent's game plan with disruption spells like Get Lost and Temporary Lockdown, while building up card advantage through Meticulous Archive and Stock Up. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Marang River Regent and Roiling Dragonstorm to close out the game quickly once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control spells such as Lightning Helix, Get Lost, and Dispelling Exhale to disrupt the opponent's strategy while efficiently managing resources with cards like Stock Up and Meticulous Archive. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Beza, the Bounding Spring and Marang River Regent to close out games. Additionally, the mana base is designed to provide the necessary colors for the control spells and aims to outvalue the opponent by maintaining card advantage and board control throughout the game.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a mix of low-cost creatures, disruptive spells, and powerful finishers. The deck aims to establish board control early on with aggressive creatures like Nurturing Pixie and Sunpearl Kirin, while using cards like Hopeless Nightmare and Temporary Lockdown to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Overlord of the Balemurk serve as powerful late-game threats to close out the game. The deck also includes utility lands like Bleachbone Verge and Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber to support its aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful and aggressive creatures like Emberheart Challenger, Hired Claw, and Magebane Lizard. Supporting cards such as Burst Lightning and Monstrous Rage help deal additional damage and control the board. The goal is to quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, ultimately leading to victory by overwhelming them with relentless attacks and spell damage. This deck aims to end the game as quickly as possible and prevent the opponent from stabilizing.

The key strategy of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly swarm the board with small aggressive creatures like Drake Hatcher, Monastery Swiftspear, and Cori-Steel Cutter, while using cards like Opt, Sleight of Hand, and Stock Up to maintain card advantage and consistency. Spells like Into the Flood Maw, Monstrous Rage, and Torch the Tower help deal damage and clear the way for attacks. The deck also utilizes countermagic with Spell Pierce and Burst Lightning for additional control. The mana base of Islands, Mountains, and dual lands allows for efficient casting of spells.

Utilizing a mix of evasive creatures and removal spells, this deck aims to maintain tempo and close out games swiftly.
